name: Attabad Lake (landslide-dammed control)
coord_source: A point on the lake, about 190 m from shore, inside OpenStreetMap way 60065056 (Attabad lake, ODbL); SARtale location check, 10 Nov 2026

name: Shisper / Mochowar ice-dammed lake
coord_source: The ice-dammed lake's basin at the Muchuhar–Shisper confluence: Sentinel-2 water centroids 74.5656 E, 36.3593 N (0.32 km², 25 May 2020) and 74.5681 E, 36.3577 N (0.20 km², 5 Apr 2022); HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (CC0) lake point 74.572267 E, 36.35594 N, events GF 499–516
downstream: Hassanabad village and the Karakoram Highway bridge
lake_state_source: no water in the basin in Sentinel-2, 17 Aug 2026 (clearest scene of 1 Jul–30 Sep 2026); the lake last held water in spring 2022 and burst on 7 May 2022

name: Passu terminal lake
coord_source: Event table, doi:10.1016/j.rcar.2025.03.005; within 50 m of HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (CC0) 74.879432 E, 36.457073 N

name: Khurdopin ice-dammed lake
coord_source: HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (Zenodo 18257243, CC0) lake point, the dataset of Shrestha et al. 2023, ESSD 15:3941
lake_state_source: the basin against the Khurdopin glacier tongue is a dry sediment flat in Sentinel-2, 17 Aug 2026 (clearest scene of 1 Jul–30 Sep 2026); the lake last formed in 2017–2021 (HMAGLOFDB events 2017, 2018 and 2021)

name: Karambar glacier terminus pond (historic ice-dam site)
coord_source: HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (CC0), lake GL074079E36622N; a terminus pond of about 0.05–0.08 km² sits at this point in Sentinel-2, Jul–Sep 2026

name: Rogheli glacier lake (Chitral)
lake_state_source: the dark radar area is a narrow gully strip of ice and intermittent water; Sentinel-2 shows a 0.17 km² water-like strip on 30 Aug 2026 and less water on other summer 2026 dates (median 0.05 km²)
